name: Shinima Junjou
source: Junjou is skinnier than average. He has a sickly and malnourished appearance due to his pale skin and frayed hair. He has little to no self esteem, and is also a pessimist. Unexpectedly, Junjou is very curious, and often enjoys to observe the people around him.
